generic_sampling_rules.integer_pk: Sequential from 1; unique; never NULL; declared INTEGER; exclude every compact-DB PK value of the same table (coerce non-int PKs to int for the taken-set) and every UNIQUE column value so generated rows are never skipped.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_fk: Copy from parent PK pool; allow parent rows without children; NULL only if column nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_short_enum: Sample from the enum pool of the column; near-variants (case/whitespace) only where listed in per_column_exceptions.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_text: Random short text; allow near-duplicates; NULL only if nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.varchar_numeric_string: Numeric string with 2 decimals, e.g. printf('%.2f', x); NULL only if nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.datetime: Random datetime in 2008-01-01..2018-03-31; respect table date-order rules; NULL only if nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: For each nullable column, plant at least one NULL row per instance and persist it through the writer (verify the written rows contain the NULLs); share ~ observed null_rate (0.0 here means rare, still plant >=1 NULL).
generic_sampling_rules.boundary: For columns listed in per_column_exceptions with pattern comparison_boundary, include each listed literal and one near-variant (case change) only where the column has no strict IN-domain formula; where a strict IN-domain formula exists, the domain is extended to include the case variants so the boundary literals remain valid.
generic_sampling_rules.ties: For ORDER columns, include at least two rows sharing the same value at the listed rank.
generic_sampling_rules.duplicates: For DISTINCT columns, ensure 20-50% duplicate share.
generic_sampling_rules.group_sizes: Ensure groups of size 1, 2 and >=3 exist for GROUP columns.
